items.title: Peter Steinberger exited for 100 million euros.
items.summary: One hour. That is all it took. One Austrian developer, one Friday night, one hour of coding, and he built the fastest-growing software project in GitHub history. His name is Peter Steinberger. In November 2025, he was burned out. He had sold his company for 100 million euros, tried to retire and felt empty. So he booked a one-way ticket to Madrid and disa...
